gloss: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (short form)

definitions.gloss: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (abbreviation)
definitions.explanation: The everyday short form of {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}, the ministry in charge of public health, medicine, pensions, employment and working conditions. It is constantly in the news on infections, vaccines, the minimum wage and overwork.

examples.japanese: {厚労省|こうろうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The health ministry issued a warning.

examples.japanese: {厚労省|こうろうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{感染者|かんせんしゃ}→感染者：28388_kansensha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: According to the health ministry, infections are rising.

examples.japanese: {厚労省|こうろうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}{労働|ろうどう}→長時間労働：31087_choujikanroudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}めている→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧。
examples.english: The ministry is stepping up its guidance to companies in order to cut long working hours.

notes:
Formed in 2001 by merging the old {厚生省|こうせいしょう} (health and welfare) and {労働省|ろうどうしょう} (labour). News headlines and speech use {厚労省|こうろうしょう}; documents use the full name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚労省|こうろうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: a health ministry survey
- {厚労省|こうろうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: a health ministry announcement
- {厚労相|こうろうしょう}: the health minister (news short form, read the same way)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文科省|もんかしょう}→文科省：33198_monkashou⟧: the Ministry of Education, the same kind of short form
